careerSiteUrls.title: Workday career site URLs
careerSiteUrls.description: Paste any page from a company's Workday career site — the main jobs page or a single job. Both myworkdayjobs.com and myworkdaysite.com addresses work.

useCuratedList.title: Use the built-in company list
useCuratedList.description: Also fetch from our registry of verified Workday career sites, discovered from Common Crawl and checked against the live API. Combine with the filters below and a sensible Maximum jobs.

companyKeywords.title: Companies from the list (optional)
companyKeywords.description: Only use built-in list companies whose name contains one of these, e.g. "Morgan Stanley", "bank", "health". Ignored unless the built-in list is on.

searchText.title: Workday search
searchText.description: Runs Workday's own search on each site, exactly like typing into the site's search box. The fastest way to narrow a big employer.

titleKeywords.title: Title keywords
titleKeywords.description: Only roles whose title contains one of these (case-insensitive), e.g. "engineer", "nurse".

locationKeywords.title: Location keywords
locationKeywords.description: Only roles where any listed location contains one of these (case-insensitive), e.g. "Texas", "London". Multi-location roles are checked against every location.

remoteOnly.title: Remote roles only
remoteOnly.description: Only roles whose location or the company's workplace label says remote.

onlyWithSalary.title: Only jobs that state pay
onlyWithSalary.description: Only roles whose description states a pay range or rate. About 1 in 4 US Workday roles do, thanks to pay-transparency laws. Pay is read from the description, so this fetches each candidate's details.

minAnnualSalary.title: Minimum yearly pay
minAnnualSalary.description: Only roles whose pay range reaches at least this much per year, in the job's own currency. Hourly and monthly pay are converted (hour × 2,080, month × 12). Implies 'only jobs that state pay'.

salaryCurrencies.title: Pay currencies
salaryCurrencies.description: Only roles paying in these currencies, e.g. "USD", "GBP", "EUR". Implies 'only jobs that state pay'.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only roles posted in the last N days.

onlyNewSinceLastRun.title: Only jobs new since this search last ran
onlyNewSinceLastRun.description: For scheduled runs: skip every job this same search has already delivered, so you never pay for the same job twice. The first run returns all current matches. Jobs cut off by the maximum are still delivered next time. The Actor remembers each search in a key-value store named workday-jobs-monitor in your account; changing any filter starts a new history.

monitorName.title: Search name (optional)
monitorName.description: Only needed to keep two searches with identical filters separate, e.g. one per client.

includeDescription.title: Include job description
includeDescription.description: Adds the description, exact posting date, employment type, country and every location. Turn off for a faster run with titles, locations and links only.

maxJobs.title: Maximum jobs
maxJobs.description: Hard cap on results for the whole run. This is your main cost control — you are charged per job returned.

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Maximum jobs per career site
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Optional cap per career site, so one huge employer does not use up the whole run.
